planets.name: MARS

desc.text: A cold, dusty desert world. Long ago it had a watery past: scientists see ancient river valleys, deltas and lakebeds, and rocks that could only have formed in liquid water.

questions: Was Mars ever home to life?
What happened to its water and climate?
Could humans live and work there one day?

real.text: Real mission: NASA's Perseverance rover has explored Jezero Crater, an area with an ancient river delta, since 2021.
